raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The auto group count keeps only groups whose attention call fills four waves of 128-row tiles. The groups attend on their own streams, so a call's tail overlaps the next group's start, and the four-wave floor is higher than needed. MiniMax-H3 at Ulysses 4 (14 heads per rank) gets 2 groups at 1280x704 and 1344x768 because 7 two-head groups fill 3.5 and 3.9 waves, yet 7 groups are faster.

## Modifications

- Lower the floor from 4 to 3 waves. H3 now auto-selects 7 groups at both shapes; the case behind the old floor (Wan 1.3B, one-head groups, 1.7 waves) still stays sequential.
- Test assertions for the group counts at known shapes added to `test_ipc_a2a_multi_gpu.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

Head grouping does not change bits on the pipelined backends: MP4 md5 identical to main in every arm (6/6 on FA4, 4/4 forced-cuDNN).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

4x B300 (stand-in for B200), MiniMax-H3 T2VA, 49 forwards, fresh server per arm, ABBA, 1 warmup + 3 timed, server-side `inference_time_s`:

| | 1280x704 | 1344x768 |
|---|---|---|
| main | 26.72 s | 31.94 s |
| this PR | 26.55 s (-0.17) | 31.78 s (-0.16) |

B200 runs this attention through cuDNN rather than FA4, so I also forced cuDNN on the B300: main -> this PR + the alignment-row PR is -0.14 s at 704 and -0.23 s at 768, md5 identical.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit config (isort / ruff / black pass).
- [x] Add unit tests (merged into the existing test file for the touched area).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).

files.patch:
@@ -42,8 +42,11 @@
 _AUTO_PIPELINE_GROUPS = (7, 5, 4, 3, 2)
 # Each group's attention call must fill this many waves of 128-row tiles: below
 # it the call's tail costs more than the overlap saves (cuDNN SDPA on B300 runs
-# Wan 1.3B at Ulysses 4 in three one-head groups 44% slower than sequentially).
-_MIN_GROUP_WAVES = 4
+# Wan 1.3B at Ulysses 4 in three one-head groups, 1.7 waves, 44% slower than
+# sequentially). The groups attend on their own streams, so one call's tail
+# overlaps the next: MiniMax-H3 at Ulysses 4 runs 7 two-head groups (3.5 waves
+# at 1280x704, 3.9 at 1344x768) faster than 2, under FA4 and cuDNN alike.
+_MIN_GROUP_WAVES = 3
 
 
 @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)

@@ -182,10 +182,10 @@ def fill(head_start, head_count, q_dst, k_dst):
                 )
 
     # groups=-1 picks the most groups that divide the heads per rank and whose
-    # calls still fill four waves of 128-row tiles, and still matches; a shape too
+    # calls still fill three waves of 128-row tiles, and still matches; a shape too
     # small to fill them keeps the sequential exchange
     sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(rank).multi_processor_count
-    s_auto = 4 * sms * 128 // world  # one head per group fills four waves
+    s_auto = 3 * sms * 128 // world  # one head per group fills three waves
     torch.manual_seed(77)
     full = [
         torch.randn(s_auto * world, 16, 64, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
@@ -400,6 +400,38 @@ def test_two_ranks_engage_under_expandable_segments_without_pidfd_getfd(self):
         )
 
 
+class TestAutoPipelineGroups(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_group_counts_at_known_shapes(self):
+        """148 SMs: MiniMax-H3 at Ulysses 4 runs 7 two-head groups at 1280x704
+        and 1344x768; Wan 1.3B at Ulysses 4 (one head per group) stays sequential."""
+        from unittest import mock
+
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.device_communicators import (
+            ipc_a2a_multi,
+        )
+
+        def groups(rows, heads):
+            plan = ipc_a2a_multi._PipelinePlan(
+                batch=1,
+                s_local=rows // 4,
+                heads=(heads,) * 3,
+                head_dim=128,
+                replicated=(0, 0, 0),
+                replicated_first=True,
+                world=4,
+                groups=-1,
+            )
+            return ipc_a2a_multi._auto_pipeline_groups(plan)
+
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(ipc_a2a_multi, "_sm_count", return_value=148),
+            mock.patch.object(torch.cuda, "current_device", return_value=0),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(groups(33024, 56), 7)
+            self.assertEqual(groups(37120, 56), 7)
+            self.assertEqual(groups(32768, 12), 0)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     if "--worker" in sys.argv:
         if "--deny-pidfd-getfd" in sys.argv:
